_comment: What sentinel scans, and how much a finding there matters. Tier is BLAST RADIUS, not dependency count: peach-shaker-5000 has 857 transitive packages and ships to nobody yet, while agentic-sdlc has none and its contents are executed by agents with shell access. Ranking by count sorts this exactly backwards.

tiers.1: Customer data, live client sites, or code executed by agents. A finding here is escalated.
tiers.2: Live or client-facing, but without customer data at risk.
tiers.3: Personal, pre-release, or local-only. Non-exploitable classes may be de-escalated.

repos.why: The framework itself; its contents are executed by agents. Compromise here is total.
